bullets: Added a 50/50 split that locks eligible Freebuff house-subscription users to a monthly or yearly price on every visit.
Added an environment variable to set the price for accepting a sponsored compute offer, defaulting to 200 cents and stopping offers when the value is invalid.
Updated the read_files tool to show detected images as pictures instead of garbled text when the host supports it.
Added shared types standardizing how paying subscriber costs are labeled across reports.
Fixed an occasional crash when the command-line tool could not find your project folder during startup or tests.
